svg.title: From the measuring page to the right shift
svg.desc: Print the measuring page. Measure from the top-left corner of the paper to the first cross. If it is exactly 20 mm you are done; choose this printer in the preview. If not, enter the difference as the left-right and up-down shift, between -10 and 10 mm. Save, print the measuring page again and measure again.
